title: 云依助手 0.13.7
releaseNotes: Fixes packet sender multicast setup with a visible Windows IPv4 adapter selector, explicit send-interface and TTL controls, separate join/listen and leave actions, and native-confirmed membership. Network confirmation preserves targets and payload bytes; joining an unchanged active endpoint retains its allocated source port. Send controls remain visible while editing. Legacy packet libraries remain compatible. Includes synthetic UI and native loopback regressions; physical multicast networks and devices have not been exercised.
